source.source_name: Mandi, India: Open-Meteo/ECMWF IFS and CAMS global modeled grid
source.attribution: Open-Meteo; ECMWF IFS; Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global atmospheric composition forecasts
source.temporal_resolution: Hourly API positions; CAMS global underlying product is 3-hourly, approximately 45 km
source.co_location: Different weather/air grids; returned grid coordinates recorded in each receipt; no physical co-location claim
source.label_provenance: Exact +6h modeled values, no observed hazard labels
source.original_issue_time_availability: Not verified; retrospective benchmark, not replay of information known at original issue time

architecture.teacher: per-target residual XGBoost; causal lags, trailing means/stds; validation depth selection and early stopping
architecture.student: per-target 16-tree depth-3 XGBoost; equal mix of observed and teacher residuals on training rows
architecture.missing_policy: no imputation; require six finite current inputs and observed future target; teacher allows missing historical features

split.strategy: fixed future blocks; label horizon purged; no geographic validation
